Weekly Near Eastside Ride

Indianapolis, IN · Near Eastside · Social

Beginner friendly

Weekly Near Eastside Ride is a social group ride in Indianapolis, IN. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Centerpoint Brewing. About 8–12 miles, slow neighborhood pace, under 12 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at @centralincycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Weekly Near Eastside Ride group ride

A short, slow neighborhood ride from Centerpoint Brewing. Run by Central Indiana Cycling, the group formed when CIBA and Bike Indianapolis merged in 2025. Leaves on time.
